implementation.schedule_authority: SimulationRuntime routes the internal realtime-single-step-v1 profile through assemble_realtime_tick_measured; the legacy-default path remains unchanged and the public profile remains unadvertised.
implementation.eligible_runtime_scope: The production binding accepts the rigid/query native subset established by F8-33. Live fluid, deformable, smoke or coupling domains fail explicitly before tick assembly rather than silently entering a partial schedule.
implementation.fixed_tick: Each eligible tick accepts exactly one 1/60 second advance, one predict/integrate phase, one shared spatial update and publication, exactly eight AVBD iterations, and one atomic commit boundary. Catch-up, adaptive iteration counts and multi-substep requests are rejected.
implementation.adapter_bindings: CPU executes the host-native spatial service and fixed solver. CUDA and Vulkan use the common emitted Slang kernels. D3D12 binds the reflected DXIL spatial kernels. Metal uses a bounded staged encoder that emits the fixed realtime solver without the legacy intra-tick wait/readback.
implementation.atomic_boundary: Fixed work, phase and commit costs are reserved before device work. Current-state publication, clock advance and pending-input consumption happen only at commit; injected pre-commit failures preserve all three and may retry the same tick.
implementation.telemetry: Measured phase records are populated from adapter-specific encoded dispatch, workgroup, barrier, submission, byte, iteration and spatial operations. CPU encode time uses a steady-clock measurement; unavailable GPU timing remains unsupported and is not relabeled as CPU time.

production_runtime_cases: empty fixed tick advances once and commits without an index build
rigid fixed tick executes one spatial update/publication and exactly eight solver iterations
multi-substep and non-1/60 requests fail before execution
zero limits for dispatches, workgroups, bytes, index builds, index publications, numerical iterations, barriers and submissions each fail before commit
zero domain-dispatch and commit-submission limits each fail before commit
repeated rejected ticks preserve the clock, current-state selection and pending impulse; the next valid tick consumes the impulse and advances exactly once
phase and total mandatory minima are rejected by production preflight before a telemetry or schedule transaction begins
